html:
SMTO-EML-0022 — The email sender changed while this email was being prepared

GUID: a8fceed7-38c4-5603-ac52-f306256b12bd
Slug: email-profile-revision-changed
Domain: EML · Subsystem: email-smtp

What happened

  • The saved sender for this email was edited or deleted after SMTO prepared the message, so SMTO stopped rather than send with different settings. This email was not sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open More options › Parameter Store and check that the sender still exists and its settings are the ones you want. SMTO stopped because the saved sender changed, so confirm the change was intended.
  2. If you or a colleague are still editing that sender, finish the change and select Save before continuing. An email prepared before a save keeps the old settings and will be stopped again.
  3. In the same conversation, ask SMTO to prepare and send the email again, then approve the new preview. A fresh preparation picks up the sender's current settings.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows a new preview and, after you approve it, reports that the mail server accepted the email.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. If the sender was deleted, create it again in Parameter Store instead of reusing the old preview.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The selected email profile's Parameter Store revision (updated_at) no longer matches the revision bound at preparation, or the record was removed before dispatch.

What this means

  • The saved sender profile was changed or removed after preparation. The producer identifies the failed field or preparation stage without exposing private values.

Why this can happen

  • The current record differs from the preparation revision or a preflight-selected record disappeared.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reported field, failure phase and retained receipt before choosing a correction.

How to fix it

  • Compare the profile record's current updated_at with the revision bound in the execution context (_auth_source_revisions or parameter_references bindings). Prepare a new operation so it binds the current revision; this attempt stopped before the send call was dispatched to the Gateway.
  • Reload the current profile and prepare the operation again using its current revision.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first. Retry only when existing execution and effect evidence permits it; reconcile an uncertain prior send.

How to verify the fix

  • Preparation uses the current saved profile revision.

What not to do

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.

Technical notes

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors
